messages:
taylor (sales): FYI Trident just confirmed they'd like a 4-week technical POC. High level asks: DPA, SOC2 evidence, pen-test window, GDPR data residency, and a pricing sketch for a small dedicated pool. Also want clear success criteria and evals. Can we scope?

mike (solutions): +1. I can own the eval plan and sample prompts. Quick q: will they use PII-ish product data or synthetic? affects storage/encryption needs.

taylor (sales): They said a mix of anonymized production snippets and synthetic records. HIPAA might come up later but not initial. Data residency: EU-only for the POC.

anya (security): EU region + anonymized data is fine. For the DPA we need a signed template + data processing addendum. For SOC2 we can provide the cert and the most recent trust report (redacted). Pen-test: we require a scoped authorization + schedule; typical lead time 2–3 weeks. Need to know attack surface (hosted API vs private deployment).

mike (solutions): Proposed POC plan (short):
- Week 0: kickoff, data access, auth, sign DPA
- Week 1: ingest sample prompts + eval harness, baseline hosted runs
- Week 2: tune batching/quant profiles, run perf tests (latency/cost)
- Week 3: run quality evals, iterate prompts, embed/regression checks
- Week 4: wrap, handoff + final report
Success criteria (suggested):
- Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 85% on 500 holdout prompts
- Perf: p99 latency < 250ms for 1–2 RPS sustained on hosted, or equivalent on Dedicated
- Cost: per-token estimate <= quoted threshold (TBD)

mike (solutions): Sample eval prompt set snippet:
```
Q: Summarize the following product spec in 2 bullets.
Input: <spec text>
Expected: concise pros, 1 risk note
```
We'll build a small harness (pytest-like) to run prompts and compute pass/fail.

anya (security): For pen-test scope options:
- Option A: Redwood-hosted API only (we control infra) — shorter review window
- Option B: Customer-facing private VPC endpoint — needs network ACLs and scheduled window, require customer IOA
Pen-test deliverables we need from vendor: test plan, signed consent, and final report. We also require vuln triage SLA (48h) for critical findings during POC.

rahul (legal): I can push an expedited DPA + BAA draft if HIPAA becomes required. For SOC2 we can share the cert and a redacted report; full report only on NDA. DPA turnaround typical 3–5 business days if no custom clauses. Note: Trident asked about subprocessors list — we'll include current infra and telemetry processors.

jen (customer-success): I'll create a POC runbook for Trident with onboarding checklist (creds, allowed IPs, sample data format) and schedule the weekly sync. Also will collect the 500 eval prompts from their SME.

mike (solutions): One more technical: they asked about quantization/latency tradeoffs. For the POC we can run hosted with a quantized 4-bit profile to show cost reduction, but we'll also run an unquantized baseline for quality comparison. Need to log token counts per prompt.

ops-bot: New workspace created: poc-trident-1743214567. Access: taylor, mike, jen, anya, rahul.

anya (security): Action items for security: provide SOC2 cert, share DPA template, confirm pen-test windows (need 2-week lead), provide recommended IP allowlist for EU region.

rahul (legal): Action items for legal: send DPA template + subprocessors, prepare BAA stub, confirm any custom indemnities (none expected).

mike (solutions): Action items for solutions: build eval harness, load sample prompts (we'll start with 200), run baseline tests by end of Week 1, produce interim perf report.

taylor (sales): OK next steps: I'll send Trident an SOW draft with the 4-week timeline and the preliminary pricing bands (hosted pilot vs small dedicated). Book a kickoff Wed 10am UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

anya (security): Also flag: if customer asks for penetration testing against private infra we require a short PO and authorized scope doc before any external tests.

jen (customer-success): I'll post the onboarding doc and a short sample CSV template in the workspace by EOD.

mike (solutions): One more note on success criteria: add a manual QA pass (2 SME reviewers) on a 50-sample set to catch hallucinations.

taylor (sales): Great — putting these into the SOW. Meeting invite sent.

anya (security): I'll share the SOC2 cert link in the workspace privately.

rahul (legal): I'll drop the DPA + BAA drafts into the workspace after today's review.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-sync-poc-trident at 2024-12-04T10:00:00Z

mike (solutions): All set on my side, ping me if Trident's SME wants to tweak eval metrics.

jen (customer-success): Thanks team — will shepherd customer comms.

taylor (sales): Thanks everyone, closing thread for now.
